lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits, with a higher spatial frequency observed in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a rectangular lattice of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher-intensity pixels on the dorsal-facing edge and lower-intensity shadow-casting pixels on the ventral-facing edge.
